name: Client-only "Unsaved changes" badge via UnsavedHint JS hook (app.js:32-48; components.ex:124-131)
reason: Web-only mechanic. The LiveView batches a form and badges it dirty through a JS hook; every native control applies as it is changed and the daemon confirms it, so there is no unsaved state for a badge to report.

name: next_step / previous_step
reason: Web-only mechanic. The browser door is a twelve-tab wizard with next and previous; the native panes are a list in a fixed order, and there is nothing to step through.

name: previous_step
reason: Web-only mechanic. The same wizard navigation as the plugins tab's next and previous, on the last tab, where it can only go back.

name: Restart overlay "Restarting Fermix… This page reconnects automatically." (components.ex:74-87)
reason: Web-only mechanic. The overlay exists because the page's own socket drops when the daemon restarts and has to reconnect itself; the native restart is a sheet whose ladder reports the transaction the app is running.
